title: Provide Deal Performance Feedback Request
description: Request parameters for sending DSP-side performance metrics back to the curator. Enables closed-loop optimization by sharing data the curator cannot access through SSP reporting alone (clicks, conversions, viewability from the buyer's DSP).

deal_id.description: Protocol-level deal ID to provide feedback for

performance_index.description: Normalized performance score (0-10). Allows comparison across different metric types. 5 = meets expectations, >7 = strong performance, <3 = underperforming.

dsp_metrics.description: DSP-observed metrics for the measurement period. These are metrics the curator cannot access through SSP reporting.

impressions.description: DSP-counted impressions (may differ from SSP count due to discrepancies)

ctr.description: Click-through rate as a decimal (clicks / impressions)

conversions.description: Total conversions attributed to this deal

viewability_rate.description: Viewability rate as a decimal (viewable impressions / measured impressions)

notes.description: Free-text feedback or optimization requests (e.g., 'This deal is underperforming on conversions — consider refreshing the segment targeting').
